text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she ran frantically and claimed 
victory over Air Groove, Mejiro Dober 
realizes she is still trembling from Air 
Groove's overwhelming aura.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Can she truly say she has become like Air 
Groove now? Inside her chest, nothing but 
impatience remained—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment she returned to the waiting 
room, she expressed a fierce desire to 
enter the Takarazuka Kinen, but watching 
her desperately trying to become like Air 
Groove brought back an uneasy feeling of 
dissonance once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, unable to immediately put the 
unsettling feeling into words, for now, 
Mejiro Dober's next goal was set on the 
Takarazuka Kinen...
